test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing to a boy, a teacher said, "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband." How is the boy related to the teacher?
solution:
• "His sister is the daughter of my mother's husband."
 
• “My mother’s husband”
 
• This is simply the teacher’s father.
 
• “The daughter of my mother’s husband”
 
• The daughter of the teacher’s father = the teacher’s sister.
 
• “His sister is the teacher’s sister”
 
• The boy’s sister is the teacher’s sister.
 
• So the boy and the teacher share the same sister → they are siblings.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
